A: Explicit decomposition; prefix A and tail A, no adjacent basis reuse
B: Explicit decomposition; prefix B and closed tail B; virtual all-B construction
NATIVE_MIXED: Prefix A + q closed tail B occurrences + single native scalar + per-axis wrapper; not interpolation of total A/B columns
phase_uncertainty: Keep lower/upper; no midpoint; up to one ancilla phase gate per closed occurrence under the existing counter
expectation: all supplied finite-law orders; not the compiled population mean
same_event_comparison: Requires separately validated event/basis/scalar/wrapper lineage; no such full envelope certified here
